Change colour and fit the chart: Gbanwee agba ma dabara na eserese ahụ

Amigurumi are small stuffed toys, worked: Amigurumi bụ obere ihe egwuregwu ụmụaka juru eju, na-arụ ọrụ na spirals otu crochet nwere akara na mmalite nke agba ọ bụla.

Toy safety comes first. For babies and c: Nchekwa egwuregwu ụmụaka na-ebute ụzọ. Maka ụmụ ọhụrụ na ụmụaka na-erubeghị afọ 3, akwa akwa na anya na imi nwere yarn. Obere akụkụ ndị na-atọpụ bụ ihe egwu na-akpagbu.
Use new, clean polyester toy stuffing, n: Jiri ihe ọhụrụ eji egwuri egwu polyester dị ọcha, ọ bụghị ndochi ohiri isi ochie ma ọ bụ akwa akwa. Tụkwa aka na ntị n'ime ahụ ọtụtụ ugboro.

Time 10 rows to know your real hours: Oge ahịrị 10 iji mara ezigbo awa gị
To remember. Weigh and measure one block: Icheta. Tụọ ma tụọ otu square akpọchiri, wee mụbaa. Mee ka okirikiri ahụ gụọ ọtụtụ nke motif. Tinye stitches 6 nke ọ bụla na-abawanye gburugburu.

Measure over light clothing, explain eac: Jiri uwe dị mfe tụọ ihe, kọwaa nke ọ bụla tupu i were ya, ma debe kaadị ahụ nzuzo. Dee ụbọchị, n'ihi na ahụ na-agbanwe.

About 2.5 to 5 cm of ease. For fitted ca: Ihe dị ka 2.5 ruo 5 cm dị mfe. Maka cardigans dabara adaba na n'elu.
About 5 to 10 cm of ease. For everyday j: Ihe dị ka 5 ruo 10 cm dị mfe. Maka ndị jumpers na cardigans kwa ụbọchị.
About 10 to 15 cm for relaxed tops, 15 c: Ihe dị ka 10 ruo 15 cm maka elu dị jụụ, 15 cm ma ọ bụ karịa maka mkpuchi mkpuchi buru ibu.

Chioma turns a body into stitches: Chioma na-atụgharị ahụ ka ọ bụrụ stitches

Front and back: 106 / 2 = 53 cm each: Ihu na azụ: 106/2 = 53 cm nke ọ bụla
For example, Chioma in Asaba is knitting: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, Chioma dị na Asaba na-akpa akwa jumper dabara adaba maka onye ahịa nwere bọt 98 cm. Ọ na-agbakwunye 8 cm nke ịdị mfe, maka agba agba agbachara nke 106 cm. Ihu na azụ bụ 53 cm nke ọ bụla.

Try the yoke on before you separate the: Gbalịa yok tupu ị kewaa aka uwe.
Each increase round adds 8 stitches: Gburugburu mmụba ọ bụla na-agbakwunye 8 stitches
Sleeves need 24 rounds, then body only: Aka uwe chọrọ okirikiri 24, emesia ahụ naanị

With a new yarn at 20 stitches per 10 cm: N'iji yarn ọhụrụ dị na stitches 20 kwa 10 cm, olu Chioma 50 cm bụ 100 stitches: 34 azụ, 34 n'ihu, na 16 maka aka uwe ọ bụla.

With a plain round between increases, th: Site na okirikiri dị larịị n'etiti mmụba, yok dị ihe dịka 23 cm miri emi. Tupu ọ kewaa uwe aka ya, ọ tụbara stitches ahụ na eriri ogologo ma nwalee ya.
Pick up about 3 stitches for every 4 row: Were ihe dị ka stitches 3 maka ahịrị anọ ọ bụla.
Remove 12 buttonhole and 6 end stitches: Wepu oghere bọtịnụ 12 na stitches njedebe 6
Stitches are wider than rows are tall, s: Stitches dị obosara karịa ahịrị dị ogologo, yabụ ị nweghị ike iburu otu stitch kwa ahịrị. Ntuziaka nkịtị bụ stitches 3 maka ahịrị anọ ọ bụla.
For example, Aisha in Ilorin has a 130-r: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, Aisha na Ilorin nwere ọnụ ọnụ nke dị 130 ahịrị. Oke ya bụ 22 kewara site na 30, ihe dị ka 0.73, yabụ ọ chọrọ ihe dị ka stitches 95.

She picks up 98 and spaces the holes 16: Ọ na-eburu 98 wee kesaa oghere 16 stitches iche. Mgbe ahụ ọ na-enyocha mkpokọta 98.
Blocking safely, fibre by fibre: Na-egbochi n'enweghị nsogbu, eriri site na eriri

Cotton, linen and viscose smell like bur: Owu, linen na viscose na-esi ísì dị ka akwụkwọ na-ere ọkụ wee hapụ ntụ ntụ ntụ dị nro. Ajị anụ na-esi ísì dị ka ntutu na-ere ọkụ ma na-ewepụta onwe ya. Synthetics na-agbaze ka ọ bụrụ bead siri ike, ma nwee ike ịgbasa ma gbaa akpụkpọ ahụ ọkụ.

Instead of making one of everything, cho: Kama ịme otu n'ime ihe niile, họrọ ngwaahịa ole na ole na ọkwa atọ. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, Tolu na Abeokuta na-ahazi nchịkọta maka agbamakwụkwọ, ememe ịkpọ aha na onyinye.
Her good item is a coaster set that take: Ihe dị mma ya bụ ihe na-ewe ihe dị ka elekere 1 ma weta ndị ahịa ọhụrụ. Ihe kacha mma ya, onye na-ere ahịa bụ isi, bụ obere akpa teepu. Ihe kacha mma ya bụ blanket nwa omenala nwere mmalite nke nwa.
She uses one colour story, cream, mustar: Ọ na-eji otu akụkọ agba, ude, mọstad na indigo, ya mere foto ya yiri ọkachamara ọnụ. Ọ na-edekwa kaadị ngwaahịa maka nke ọ bụla, ya na yarn, nko, gram, oge na nha, ya mere obere akpa 20 dabara na nke mbụ.
For example, Mercy prices her scarf: 180: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, Mercy na-ere ịchafụ ya: 180g yarn, awa 10.5, na narị naira 800 n'otu elekere.
Ọnụ ahịa Naira bụ ihe atụ.
Handmade work is often underpriced becau: Ọrụ ejiri aka na-adịkarị ọnụ ala n'ihi na onye rụrụ ya na-agụ naanị yarn. Ọnụ ahịa ziri ezi na-ekpuchi ihe, oge gị, òkè nke ụgwọ ọrụ na uru.
Mercy's yarn costs about 2,500 naira per: Yarn Mercy na-efu ihe dị ka puku naira abụọ na narị ise n'otu bọọlụ 100, yabụ naịra iri abụọ na ise kwa gram. 180 g ya na-eri 4,500, gbakwunyere 500 maka mkpado na nkwakọ ngwaahịa.
Her time is 10.5 hours at 800 naira an h: Oge ya bụ awa 10.5 na narị naira asatọ n'otu elekere: 8,400.
She adds 10 percent overhead, and 25 per: Ọ na-agbakwụnye pasent 10 karịa, yana uru pasent 25.
That is 18,425 naira, which she rounds t: Nke ahụ bụ naira 18,425, nke ọ na-agbago ruru puku iri na asatọ na narị ise dị ka ọnụ ahịa n'ùkwù ya.
Profit as a percentage of cost. Mercy's: Uru dị ka pasent nke ọnụ ahịa. Uru 3,685 Mercy nwetara bụ 25% nke ọnụ ahịa ya.
Profit as a percentage of price: 20%. A: Uru dị ka pasent nke ọnụahịa: 20%. Mbelata 20% ga-ehichapụ uru ya niile.
Shop keeps 30%? Divide by 0.7. 18,500 /: Ụlọ ahịa na-edobe 30%? Kewaa site na 0.7. 18,500/0.7 pụtara ọnụ ahịa ụlọ ahịa ihe dịka 26,500.
Markup is profit as a percentage of cost: Markup bụ uru dị ka pasent nke ọnụ ahịa. Mercy gbakwunyere pasent 25.
Margin is profit as a percentage of the: Oke bụ uru dị ka pasentị nke ọnụahịa ire ere. Oke ya dị pasent 20, yabụ mbelata pasent 20 ga-ehichapụ uru ya niile. Lelee mbelata ego mgbe niile ka ọ bụrụ oke.
In consignment, a shop pays you only aft: Na mbubata, ụlọ ahịa na-akwụ gị ụgwọ naanị mgbe ihe rere ere, ma na-edobe ọrụ. Ọ bụrụ na ọ na-edobe pasent 30, kesaa ọnụ ahịa ịre ahịa site na 0.7. Ọnụ ahịa ụlọ ahịa kwesịrị ịdịkarịa ala ihe dịka puku naira iri abụọ na isii na narị ise. Kwekọrịta n'okwu a na ederede.
